text.p: Tokheim Corp said Monday it has completed acquisition of the petroleum dispensing marketing and services business of Paris, France-based Sofitam S.A. in a transaction valued at about $108 million.
The value of the transaction may be adjusted, it said.

Tokheim said that based on fiscal 1995 year-end results, the acquisition makes it, with pro forma combined sales in excess of $400 million, the world's largest independent designer, manufacture, and servicer of electronic and mechanical petroleum dispensing marketing systems.

Products include service station equipment, point-of-sale control systems and cash- and credit-card-activated transaction systems. The company has facilities throughout Europe, Britain, Africa, the United States and Canada.

"Specifically, the Tokheim/Sofitam combination consolidates our respective relative strengths in Northern and Southern Europe and Africa and represents a significant augmentation to Tokheim's recently established strong presence in Asia Pacific and Eastern and Central Europe," Tokheim president Douglas Pinner said in a statement.

The transaction was financed principally by the private placement of $100 million principal amount of 11-1/2 percent senior subordinated 10-year notes and part of an $80 million bank credit facility, Tokheim said.
